name: Office Time Counter
subtitle: Automated Attendance & Geofencing
tagline: Automated attendance tracking, geofencing, and work-life balance wellness utility.
description:
Master your work-life balance with intelligent, automated attendance tracking. Seamlessly log your "In" and "Out" times using advanced Geofencing and notification hooks.

Powerful Automation

📍 Smart Geofencing

Automated arrival and departure detection using background location. High-accuracy tracking that knows exactly when you're at work.

🔔 Notification Hooks

Listen for specific organizational app notifications to trigger logs, ensuring backup reliability for every shift.

📉 Real-Time Analytics

Instantly see your daily delta and weekly pending hours. Stay ahead of your targets with zero manual math.

📅 Visual History

A clean, intuitive calendar view of your entire month. Track patterns, identify gaps, and export your data easily.

🚀 Getting Started

Step 1: Configure Office Location

Open settings and pin your office location on the map. Set a comfortable radius (e.g. 200m) to trigger Geofence reliably.

Step 2: Grant Permissions

Enable Location (Always Allow) and Notification Access. These are essential for detecting movements in the background.

Step 3: Set Weekly Targets

Define required work hours (e.g. 40 hours/week). The app automatically calculates your progress in real time.

Step 4: Manual Adjustments

Forget your phone? Easily add Half-Day, Full-Day, or manual time entries to keep your history accurate.
